proposal: No new chart-eligible or trend-eligible national employment observations. The source review improves provenance and preserves the existing contextual observations as separate, non-comparable series.

series_updates.producer: Beijing Gamma New Media Culture Communication Co., Ltd. / Gamma Data (CNG)
series_updates.release_venue: Standalone CNG report; no congress or official GPC venue is identified in the report or contemporaneous CNG-byline release.
series_updates.exact_scope: Personnel scale of major listed game companies, as printed. The report supplies no constituent list, count, selection rule, domestic versus overseas allocation, game-segment allocation, or contractor treatment.
series_updates.source_locator: PDF pp. 1-2 (issuer/author) and p. 8 (chart and CNG source footer)
series_updates.eligibility: Contextual sample only. It must not be plotted as Chinese national or domestic game-only employment, and the annual values must not be combined with H1 observations.

series_updates.producer: Gamma Data (CNG), in joint talent/education research with Perfect World Education
series_updates.source_locator: China News Service report of 2018 joint salary survey; GameRes and Sina reports of the December CNG talent report
series_updates.eligibility: Contextual only. Original report and national-headcount method not recovered; no comparison with the listed-company panel.

government_series_review.finding: No annual national game-only workforce series verified. NBS classifies game work across multiple small classes, while its readily published employment results are broader aggregates.
classes: 6422 互联网游戏服务 (internet game services, including internet esports services)
6572 动漫、游戏数字内容服务 (animation and game digital-content services)
6513* 多媒体、游戏动漫和数字出版软件开发 (a partial culture activity within application software development)
government_series_review.why_not_used: The 2018 economic-census release gives 9.951m workers for the entire information-transmission/software/IT-service division, including 1.443m in internet and related services and 6.762m in software/IT services, but not a game-only total. The official culture-new-form grouping combines 16 small industries.

followup_cng_listed_company_reports.definition: For the 2026 report's own panels, major listed game companies are Chinese listed companies in 2025 game-revenue TOP50 whose 2025 game revenue exceeds 30% of total revenue; historical chart coverage is restricted to companies disclosing values in all corresponding periods.
followup_cng_listed_company_reports.scope_caveat: This definition is not printed in the 2025 new-productive-forces report and therefore cannot be assumed to define its p. 8 personnel chart.
followup_cng_listed_company_reports.workforce_result: No personnel/headcount aggregate or historical workforce chart found in the 2026 release or in the inspected 2024 and 2025 full listed/non-listed company reports. No new observations proposed.
